script_text: Aries, what the cosmos has planned this week for you, the proud Fire sign ruled by Mars, is nothing short of extraordinary. Early in the week, Venus trines your 5th House of romance, lighting a spark of passion and creative joy — Monday and Tuesday glow with unexpected love connections and bold self-expression. But Wednesday hits different: Mercury squares your 1st House, bringing sharp words and miscommunications you absolutely must navigate carefully — pause before you react. The turning point arrives Thursday when Jupiter sextiles your 10th House of career, opening a rare window for professional breakthroughs and financial gains. Ride that momentum into the weekend as Mars energizes your sign, fueling confidence in love and ambition alike. Monday is your power day because Venus harmonizes your romance zone, but Wednesday is your caution day due to Mercury's tense square. Lean into creative passion and let it lead you forward.
